components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with spaces, dashes
            and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in
            E.164 form (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no country code is
            given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner has the same last name and address (i.e. they share a household).
            Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners of the same household — owners
                with the same last name and address who opted in with 'sharesHousehold'.
                Assigned when an owner joins an existing household; otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last
                name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: The owner's membership tier — 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an
                email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's canonical region, derived from the city via the pinned
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## What I implemented

`bulkSignupWarning` is a per-owner fact fixed at creation time (like `namesakeCount` / `customerCode`), and the acceptance test reads it back via `GET /api/owners/{id}` — so it needs to be computed during the create pipeline, persisted, and exposed through the DTO.

**New logic, each in its own small unit:**

- **`OwnerRegistrationDays`** — a shared counter (mirroring the existing `OwnerCities` helper) that returns how many existing owners were registered on a given day. This is the "single definition" of grouping-by-day.
- **`AssignOwnerBulkSignupWarning`** — a create-pipeline step that sets the flag `true` when more than 80 owners were *already* registered on the new owner's business day, else `false`. Runs after `BuildOwner`, before `SaveOwner`, mutating the built entity in place — same shape as `AssignOwnerNamesakeCount`.

**Reuse instead of duplication:**

- Refactored **`RejectDailyOwnerLimit`** to call the same `OwnerRegistrationDays.size(...)` helper (it had its own inline copy of the count loop). Now the daily-cap rule and the bulk-warning rule count a day identically — exactly what the test comment ("shares the same accumulation path exercised by the daily-limit rule") calls for.

**Plumbing:**

- `Owner` entity: `bulkSignupWarning` field + `bulk_signup_warning` column, added to all four `schema.sql` dialects.
- `openapi.yml`: `bulkSignupWarning` boolean on the `Owner` schema — MapStruct maps it straight through by name (both create and GET responders reuse `toOwnerDto`).
- `OwnerMapper.toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)`: ignore the new server-assigned field, matching the existing `customerCode`/`householdId`/`namesakeCount` ignores.
- `owners.POST.yml`: inserted the `assignBulkSignupWarning` step (under `transaction` governance) between household assignment and save.

The test asserts the `false` (fresh-create) branch, which passes; the `>80` branch follows the same counting path the daily-limit rule already relies on. Full suite: `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — BUILD SUCCESS.
